description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different models: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot shows six lines, each representing a different model, with distinct colors and marker shapes: Base (black, circle, solid) starts at around 40% and increases to approximately 45%; FT (blue, triangle down, solid) begins at around 42% and rises to about 48%; IKE (red, triangle up, solid) starts at roughly 44% and reaches around 50%; MEND (brown, diamond, solid) begins at approximately 45% and increases to about 57%; MEMIT (purple, triangle right, solid) starts at around 44% and rises to approximately 55%; and ROME (green, square, solid) begins at roughly 50% and increases to about 66%. All lines exhibit a generally increasing trend as the Co-occurrence Number increases.
